namespace Callers

    using Helpers;

    public static partial class StreamCallers
    {
        extension(global::System.IO.Stream stream)
        {
            [global::Cloning.CloneAttribute]
            public async Task CopyAndDrainAsyncClone(global::System.IO.Stream destination, global::System.Threading.CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
            {
                await stream.CopyToAsync(destination, cancellationToken);
                await stream.DrainAsync(cancellationToken);
            }
        }
